# Twent Docs

> Step-by-step guides for Twent AI agent on Android — automate apps, run Ubuntu terminal & connect 1000+ services.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://twent.xyz/docs): Twent is a personal AI agent for Android — automate any app, run a full Ubuntu terminal, and connect to 1000+ services. Free, local-first, and extensible.

## Automation

- [Automation](https://twent.xyz/docs/automation/overview): Twent automates anything on Android — UI automation, shell commands,
- [Tasker Integration](https://twent.xyz/docs/automation/tasker): Connect Twent with the Tasker automation app for advanced scenarios.

## Chat

- [Chat](https://twent.xyz/docs/chat/overview): The chat screen is where you interact with your AI assistant. Messages
- [Chat Styles](https://twent.xyz/docs/chat/chat-styles): Two display modes and extensive visual customization.
- [Floating Chat](https://twent.xyz/docs/chat/floating-chat): Use Twent in a floating overlay while doing other things. The AI can see

## Getting Started

- [Installation](https://twent.xyz/docs/getting-started/installation): Twent runs on **Android 8.0+** (API 26).
- [First Setup](https://twent.xyz/docs/getting-started/first-setup): After installing Twent, configure an AI model to talk to. Twent supports
- [Your First Chat](https://twent.xyz/docs/getting-started/first-chat): Open the chat screen and type a message. The AI can answer questions,
- [Permissions](https://twent.xyz/docs/getting-started/permissions): Twent uses Android's permission system to give AI access to device

## Legal

- [Data Deletion Instructions](https://twent.xyz/docs/legal/data-deletion): App Name: **Twent**

## More

- [Memory](https://twent.xyz/docs/more/memory): Persistent knowledge storage that survives across conversations. The AI
- [Voice](https://twent.xyz/docs/more/voice): Speak to your AI and hear it respond. Supports TTS, STT, wake word
- [Settings](https://twent.xyz/docs/more/settings): Deep customization — every aspect of Twent is configurable.
- [Toolbox](https://twent.xyz/docs/more/toolbox): Built-in utility screens for debugging, development, and system
- [Tool Reference](https://twent.xyz/docs/more/tool-reference): Complete parameter reference for all built-in tools.

## Packages

- [Packages](https://twent.xyz/docs/packages/overview): Extension system for Twent — bundles tools, dependencies, and
- [Skills](https://twent.xyz/docs/packages/skills): Pre-configured behavior bundles that teach the AI how to do specific
- [Marketplace](https://twent.xyz/docs/packages/marketplace): Browse and install community-built packages, skills, and MCP servers.

## Tools

- [Tools](https://twent.xyz/docs/tools/overview): 40+ built-in tools give AI real capabilities on your device. Every tool
- [File System Tools](https://twent.xyz/docs/tools/file-system): Read, write, search, and manage files on your device and in the built-in
- [Shell & Terminal](https://twent.xyz/docs/tools/shell): Full Ubuntu 24 environment on your phone — apt, Python, Node.js, vim,
- [Web Tools](https://twent.xyz/docs/tools/web): Browse the web, search, and download content.
- [Media Tools](https://twent.xyz/docs/tools/media): Full FFmpeg, camera, OCR, image analysis, and speech processing built
- [UI Automation](https://twent.xyz/docs/tools/ui-automation): The most powerful feature — the AI can see your screen and interact with
- [JavaScript Tools](https://twent.xyz/docs/tools/javascript): Built-in JS engine for running custom code. Supports file I/O, HTTP,
- [MCP Tools](https://twent.xyz/docs/tools/mcp): Model Context Protocol — a standard for giving AI access to external

## Workflows

- [Workflows](https://twent.xyz/docs/workflows/overview): Multi-step automations combining triggers, conditions, and actions.
- [Workflow Examples](https://twent.xyz/docs/workflows/examples): Trigger: Daily at 7:30am. Steps: get calendar events → get weather → AI
